answer: The lantern report reveals the merge explicitly at each ivory. Each collapsed cluster gets one comet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 17 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 265 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3216 identities would post 1211 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
